Only originally selected input; camera/material/current installed material/raw renderer state/actual binding/range/CPU generation/resource content/Model-call and callback changes reject before commit.
Actual patched setters from late GetRenderTarget and reference Release invalidate witness; failed setter still changes serial and calls original once.
Actual CreateStateBlock and EndStateBlock results are hooked; late Apply rejects; final Release nulls table and nested Read/selected entry reject before freed-table access.
DetachedMutation releases recursive guard across external Reset window (bounded other-thread try_lock) but active witness reads and selected entry reject; old token never revives.
Normal API error returns committed=true and blocks later calls; no separate postCommitFault absent mutation.
Precommit allocation failure preserves fallback; exception inside entered API and allocation failure after successful API retain exactly one call and correct counters/ownership.
ScopedOpaqueAlphaTest recovers actual original native alpha only with its matching witness; comparison mode and missing-witness fallback tested; native material untouched and D3D function restored.

current native installed material and raw renderer cache

contract.preCommit: Return false and retain previous path on any rejection or allocation failure.
contract.commit: Before the single DrawInstance call; return true after entering API even if error or later allocation failure.
contract.postCommitFault: Cannot undo an entered API call; latch selected path after error/currentness failure, no duplicate fallback for that call.
counters: postCommitFaults counts independent late faults, not the normal API error alone

stateWitness.serial: Changes before and after original mutation, including failed setters.
stateWitness.coverage: Actual current vtable slots of device and all tracked live state blocks; fail closed for missing coverage/known alias gaps.
stateWitness.releaseBlock: Mutation encloses original destructor; nested reads reject before accessing destroyed block table.
stateWitness.reset: DetachedMutation keeps observation invalid across external Reset without retaining recursive guard.

limitations: No live game/server/GPU results attributed to this source contract.
No universal stable game-object lifetime or unsupported cohort claim.
Original producers still execute; selected consumer replaces only the final qualified indexed draw.
Whole-support offscreen omission policy remains a separate consumer.
Recording API SUCCESS is not renderer acceptance; current client bridge DrawInstance reports enqueue without separate ACK.
